title: Baby-G Digital Watch BG-169CMB-8DR
description:
Why do ordinary camouflage when you can go camo in color? BABY-G takes the ever-popular street fashion camouflage to a whole new place.

We begin with the BG-169 with its charmingly compact round form and face protectors. Then we add a bezel and band dressed in colorful camouflage that cleverly conceals the brand’s iconic G-mark, bringing a playful touch to a typically utilitarian design.

Choose your favorite of three bold and bright Y2K-style colors: pink, gray, or blue green.

This special design perfectly embodies the essence of street fashion with original camo and striking color. Add a unique touch to your style with a bold new look.
features: Mute feature Button operation tone on/off
